        public override global::System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<string> SwitchableTools => ["note_ticket"];

        protected override global::Typeshift.RunOptions ApplySettings(
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.AI.ChatOptions options,
            global::Typeshift.RunOptions run,
            Settings settings)
            => run;

        protected override global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<global::Microsoft.Extensions.AI.AITool> CreateTools(
            global::Demo.TriageAgent agent,
            global::System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<Settings> layers,
            global::Typeshift.Generated.ToolJson json)
        {
            global::Demo.SearchSettings searchTicketsSettings = agent._typeshift.searchTickets ?? new();

            foreach (var layer in layers)
            {
                searchTicketsSettings = layer.SearchTickets?.ApplyTo(searchTicketsSettings) ?? searchTicketsSettings;
            }

            global::Demo.SearchSettings searchTicketsEnabledSettings = agent._typeshift.searchTicketsEnabled ?? new();

            foreach (var layer in layers)
            {
                searchTicketsEnabledSettings = layer.SearchTicketsEnabled?.ApplyTo(searchTicketsEnabledSettings) ?? searchTicketsEnabledSettings;
            }

            var noteTicketOffered = true;

            foreach (var layer in layers)
            {
                noteTicketOffered = layer.NoteTicketEnabled ?? noteTicketOffered;
            }

            return
            [
                global::Demo.TicketToolset.TypeshiftGenerated.CreateSearchTickets(searchTicketsSettings, json),
                .. (noteTicketOffered ? new global::Microsoft.Extensions.AI.AITool[] { new global::Microsoft.Extensions.AI.ApprovalRequiredAIFunction(global::Demo.TicketToolset.TypeshiftGenerated.CreateNoteTicket(json)) } : []),
                global::Demo.TicketToolset.TypeshiftGenerated.CreateSearchTicketsEnabled(searchTicketsEnabledSettings, json)
            ];
        }

        public sealed class Configured
        {
            public global::Demo.SearchSettings? searchTickets;
            public global::Demo.SearchSettings? searchTicketsEnabled;
        }

        public sealed class SearchTicketsBuilder(Configured configured)
        {
            /// <summary>
            /// Sets <c>Limit</c>.
            /// </summary>
            /// <param name="value">The value the tool runs with in this agent.</param>
            /// <returns>The settings, to set another member.</returns>
            public SearchTicketsBuilder WithLimit(int value)
            {
                configured.searchTickets = (configured.searchTickets ?? new()) with { Limit = value };
                return this;
            }
        }

        public sealed class SearchTicketsEnabledBuilder(Configured configured)
        {
            /// <summary>
            /// Sets <c>Limit</c>.
            /// </summary>
            /// <param name="value">The value the tool runs with in this agent.</param>
            /// <returns>The settings, to set another member.</returns>
            public SearchTicketsEnabledBuilder WithLimit(int value)
            {
                configured.searchTicketsEnabled = (configured.searchTicketsEnabled ?? new()) with { Limit = value };
                return this;
            }
        }
    }
}
